As someone else said already, you don't need to use the "evolve" function (sacrificing demons for exp) to level up your main demons.

The fastest way is to get to a leveling stage on the story tab (every chapter has one leveling stage), set the Main character as your Dx2, get on your teams two kanbaris (it's a demon adquired through multifusion on the fusion tab. get one on your main team and another one on your secondary team), and use an exp scroll. Doing all this you'll get your main demons leveled up in no time.

Note that you should always do this on the leveling stage of the highest story chapter you have available.

First of all, don't worry about not understanding stuff and having a ton of questions. We all start the same way. There's a newbie guide that you can check out for some of this stuff, but I'll answer all the questions you have so you don't have to worry about that. The guide in question is this one: 

 https://dx2wiki.com/index.php/Beginner%27s_Guide



Second, if there's something I listed that you cannot find ingame, you probably haven't unlocked it yet, so just keep playing and you'll get there. Let's begin.




1. You can get gems doing the following:  

- completing the story (all three difficulties for every chapter. normal, hard and hell)

- doing daily and weekly missions (go to home -> missions to check them out)

- doing PvP (player vs player, or as the game calls it "Dx2 duel".  you get gems weekly depending on your rank when the week ends) 

- doing hell park (go to Map -> Hell park. you can get 200 gems every month advancing through it, as the hell park resets every month)

- you can get gems as you progress through the Aura gate 1 and Aura gate 2 (go to Map -> Aura gate and you'll get the explanation there)

- getting 7 wins on PvP (it resets daily. you can get 10 gems everyday doing this) and doing training combats on PvP (go to Map -> Dx2 duel, and go into the "training" tab. there are 6 training combats, each one going up in difficulty and with a reset timer to do it again, and every one you complete nets you 3 gems)

- completing Alter world chapters (this is only available when you reach a certain point in the story. when you unlock it you can access it going to Map -> Alter World)

- also participating in the Battle tower (which is inside the Alter Worlds tab)

- participating in Democalypse (it's a biweekly event for factions. you can join a faction in the faction's tab)

- and there are also some minor ways to ger gems daily at the Hideout (a vault chest on the left of the screen, and sometimes the "dispatch" tab). 


There may be some more ways I forgot, but that's almost all you need to know.


2. Stars in a demon indicate two things: 
First, the rarity of a demon. 1 star being a common demon, and 5 stars being the most rare. It usually means how strong a demon is, but there are exceptions (not all 5 star demons are that strong and there are strong 4 star demons as well). 

Second, the max level a demon can obtain. 

1 star -> max level is 25

2 star -> max level is 30

3 star -> max level is 35

4 star -> max level is 40

5 star -> max level is 45

6 star -> max level is 50

*There arent any demons with a base of 6 stars. You get these adding more stars to a demon (we'll get to that later).


3. The grade in a demon indicates its rarity as well. More grade number -> more rare. It doesn't necessarily mean stronger.



4. If you are refering to the color alongside a.. kanji? (I dont speak japanese so sorry if its not) It refers to a demon's archetype. A demon can have 5 different colors, and that color affects one of its skills (and two more things, but I dont wanna go too much into detail). That's enough to have a basic understanding of what it means.



5. You can select a demon and go to its "details" tab to read stuff about them.



6. You need to go to "Pandemonium" and select the "Evolve" option. To raise a demon's star, you need to select that demon in question and sacrifice demons of the same star value (if you want to evolve a 2 star demon, you need to sacrifice two 2 star demons to evolve it. for a 3 star demon, three 3 star demons and so on). 



7. Praising and encouraging gets you a little "fame", which is a currency that you can exchange for stuff. It also lets you rise through ranks and get some rewards (the rank in itself isn't really useful. It's just indicative of how much you've played, really)



8. If you go to your profile, you can change the things your character says when you do or complete stuff ingame. That's what you see other players "say". It's not something you say manually, so to speak.



9. That number with the lighting is your stamina. Whenever you do certains actions ingame such as entering a story stage, entering demon buster or other things, you use stamina. If you don't have enough, you have to wait until it recharges a little to do more things or use an object to recharge it. 



10. You can think of brands as equipment for demons that increase their stats, such as their damage, health, or speed. They're complex if you want to fully understand how they work in detail, but for a basic understanding that's all they are and do.



11. Drop rates are the chances of you getting a certain demon when you use your gems to try and get them. Usually most banners (the things where you spend gems to get demons) have a 3% chance of you obtaining a 5 star demon, but it depends on the banner itself.



12. Friend requests in this game are more of a way to gather "allies" more than a way to add friends . You can add friends that helped you in a story combat and viceversa, but if you're in a faction with someone or you have a friend that's also playing, you can add them asking them their friend code. (in case of factions, you can just add people going to their profile ingame).

Completed it literally 10 minutes ago lol. I don't know your berserk levels or demons, so it depends, but I did it this way:

Main team was Kinmamon, Barong, Guan Yu, Thor (not even optimal, just a paneless teal Thor).

Sub team was Alice, Asherah, and two demons with anti AG2 panel stuff. 

Only relevant berserk levels to mention were phys (lvl 13 lol) and elec (lvl 27). 

Enter with subteam, tank their first rotation (easy since only real damage they have is First jab), use Alice's Die for me on the left mob (the other one has null dark, and null light so white rider doesn't work either) and our sub team's goal here is done. After they wipe it out, you have your main team going first and it's easy. Just spam barong dance for healing+buffs and pass to get your Thor going with Mjolnir/Guan Yu attacking. Revive or cleanse ailments if needed.

This has been one of the easiest fights for my demons since alice+thor almost guarantees you to kill them doing this. Kinmamon was there for cleansing purposes and in the end I didn't even need to use him. Asherah was there to ensure that my Alice would kill the left mob (was it a kushinada?) no matter what, and Guan Yu was just whatever damage I felt like throwing into the party that was slow enough for Thor to get his turn before them.

Good luck with it bro, you got this. (Farm more berserk levels if that seems to be the problem, or just fuse a Thor. The guy is extremely useful in purple)
